description: React 19 components with Material 3 styling, built on Base UI (npm: anvilui)
rules: Import everything from 'anvilui', import 'anvilui/styles.css' once, and wrap the app in <AnvilRoot>.
Use fillType ('filled' | 'outlined' | 'text') and color ('primary' | 'tonal' | 'success' | 'warning' | 'error' | 'container' | 'surface'), never variant.
There is no asChild: use the render prop, e.g. <DialogTrigger render={<Button />}>Open</DialogTrigger>.
Icons are Material Symbols name strings: startIcon="add", <IconButton icon="delete" aria-label="Delete" />.
Callbacks receive values, not events: onValueChange(value), onCheckedChange(checked), onOpenChange(open).
Checkbox, Switch and Radio have no label prop; wrap them in <label>.
Dates are "YYYY-MM-DD" strings and times are "HH:mm" strings.
